name: v0.9.0
body:
## What's Changed

* meson: cleanup version detection by @thesamesam in https://github.com/raboof/nethogs/pull/285
* meson: fix library name by @CAB233 in https://github.com/raboof/nethogs/pull/288
* Add missing security flags and include CPPFLAGS in libnethogs by @polkorny in https://github.com/raboof/nethogs/pull/290
* Allow overriding VERSION from environment by @polkorny in https://github.com/raboof/nethogs/pull/292
* src/meson.build: remove unused ncurses++ dependency in https://github.com/raboof/nethogs/pull/304
* main,inode2prog: add missing time.h includes in https://github.com/raboof/nethogs/pull/305
* Fix 'Error opening terminal' with unknown TERM under sudo by @cengiz-io in https://github.com/raboof/nethogs/pull/308
* Exit on Ctrl-C in the curses UI by @Elias0419 in https://github.com/raboof/nethogs/pull/310

## New Contributors
* @thesamesam made their first contribution in https://github.com/raboof/nethogs/pull/285
* @CAB233 made their first contribution in https://github.com/raboof/nethogs/pull/288
* @polkorny made their first contribution in https://github.com/raboof/nethogs/pull/290
* @cengiz-io made their first contribution in https://github.com/raboof/nethogs/pull/308
* @Elias0419 made their first contribution in https://github.com/raboof/nethogs/pull/310

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/raboof/nethogs/compare/v0.8.8...v0.9.0
